items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...One is Howard Callender, who played trumpet with Eddie Diaz(?) and his Boston Brownies in 1931.

ctx.x: ...a couple of other Callenders I ran across. One is Howard Callender, who played trumpet with Eddie Diaz(?) and his Boston Brownies in 1931. You mentioned your family having lived in Boston. I wondered if Howard Callender was any relation of yours.
Well, all the Callenders come from Barbados originally, so...
